description.en: Load BEQ (Bass EQ) filters onto your DSP from your Remote via an ezBEQ server. Browse or search the BEQ catalogue and load a movie's filters to any device/slot. Works with every DSP ezBEQ supports (miniDSP, Monoprice HTP-1, JRiver, CamillaDSP, Q-SYS).

value.en: On the next screen, enter the IP address and port of your ezBEQ server. Your DSP devices, slots, and the BEQ catalogue are discovered automatically.
